description: This Java source file defines an abstract class AbstractErrorResponse, which implements an ErrorResponse interface and extends AbstractCommandResponse. It provides mechanisms to construct error responses and handle exceptions based on JSON payloads, used within the Ditto project for handling error responses.

classes.name: AbstractErrorResponse
classes.description: An abstract base class for error responses, providing mechanisms for error handling and constructing exceptions from JSON payloads.

methods.name: buildExceptionFromJson
methods.description: Creates a DittoRuntimeException based on a JSON payload, using an ErrorRegistry to parse the payload or constructing a default exception if parsing fails.
